description: This source file implements a program to create a modified 16-bit checksum for Netgear DGN3500 series routers. It includes data definitions for different PID data sets, functions to read files into memory, and a main function that calculates checksums, appends PID data, and writes the checksum to a file.

methods.name: readfile
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file into memory and returns a pointer to the buffer, setting the size of the file.
